blockerDetails.INT64_WIRE_PRECISION_POLICY_REQUIRED: Twelve int64 wire fields currently generate as JavaScript number; the approved string or bigint boundary is unresolved.
blockerDetails.RUNTIME_RESPONSE_DECODER_REQUIRED: Generated fetch code parses JSON without ERP schema and version validation at runtime.
blockerDetails.FULL_OPENAPI_SEMANTIC_VALIDATION_REQUIRE: The PoC preflight rejects the reviewed generator profile's known unsafe schema shapes, but complete OpenAPI 3.1 and JSON Schema semantic validation is not yet enforced.
blockerDetails.PACKAGE_LICENSE_PROVENANCE_REVIEW_REQUIR: The exact Orval tarball has registry integrity but no license file in its published file list; K3 provenance review remains open.
blockerDetails.NETWORK_ISOLATED_CI_REQUIRED: The local Node preload is defense in depth only; a CI runner with enforced outbound network denial is not installed.
blockerDetails.EXACT_NODE_PATCH_CI_REQUIRED: The PoC checks Node major 24, but the exact reviewed Node patch is not yet pinned by CI.
blockerDetails.OS_CONTAINER_SANDBOX_REQUIRED: No OS or container boundary currently enforces filesystem, process and network isolation for the generator.
blockerDetails.READ_ONLY_REPOSITORY_SANDBOX_REQUIRED: The PoC writes only to temporary output by inspection, but the repository is not mounted read-only by an OS sandbox.
blockerDetails.SECRETLESS_ENVIRONMENT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED: The preload scrubs environment variables in-process, but a secretless runner environment is not externally enforced.
blockerDetails.OS_CHILD_PROCESS_SANDBOX_REQUIRED: The preload deny-lists child-process APIs and brokers only the reviewed absolute Node/TypeScript invocation, but an OS policy does not prevent native or bypass child execution.
blockerDetails.CROSS_OS_DETERMINISM_REQUIRED: Two clean local Windows generations are byte-identical; an independent Linux generation and cross-OS byte comparison are missing.
blockerDetails.REACT19_VITE8_BROWSER_SMOKE_REQUIRED: Strict TypeScript compilation passes, but React 19, Vite 8 build and real-browser consumption have not run.
blockerDetails.MANUAL_DIFF_AND_MUTATION_CI_REQUIRED: Local manual-diff and requiredness/int64 mutation probes pass, but equivalent mandatory CI jobs are not installed.
blockerDetails.PROTECTED_HEADER_OVERRIDE_GUARD_REQUIRED: Current Orval fetch output lets RequestInit headers override typed X-Company-Id, Idempotency-Key, X-Correlation-Id and X-Causation-Id values; the executable adoption gate therefore rejects the generated client.
